chunks: A number of our companions, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn Abī Naṣr, from ʿĪsā al-Farrāʾ, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
When it is the Day of qiyamah, Allah, Blessed and Exalted, will command a caller to call out before Him: “Where are the poor?”

Then a great multitude from among the people will rise. He will say, “My servants,” and they will say, “Here we are, our Lord.” He will say, “I did not make you poor because of any humiliation of you before Me, but rather I chose you for the like of this day.”
“So look through the faces of the people: whoever did a kindness to you, having done it only for My sake, then repay him on My behalf with jannah.”

key_terms.اخْتَرْتُكُمْ: I chose you; indicating divine selection for honor
key_terms.الْجَنَّةِ: Paradise; the reward granted by Allah
key_terms.الْفُقَرَاءُ: the poor; those living in material need
key_terms.عِبَادِي: My servants; an address of divine honor
key_terms.مَعْرُوفًا: an act of kindness or goodness
key_terms.يَوْمُ الْقِيَامَةِ: the Day of Resurrection and final judgment

ai.seo_question: How are the poor and those who help them for Allah’s sake honored on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: This hadith describes a scene on the Day of Judgment in which Allah, Blessed and Exalted, honors the poor and clarifies that their poverty was not due to abasement before Him. It also shows the immense reward for those who showed sincere kindness to the poor for Allah’s sake, as they are recompensed with jannah.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr, from Isa Al Farr’a, from Muhammad Bin Muslim, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘When it will be the Day of Judgement, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Blessed and High will Command a Caller to Call out in front of Him<sup>azwj</sup>: ‘Where are the poor ones?’

So a lot of necks from the people would be rising. So He<sup>azwj</sup> would be Saying: “My<sup>azwj</sup> servants!” So they would be saying, ‘Here we are, our Lord<sup>azwj</sup>!’ So He<sup>azwj</sup> would be Saying: “I<sup>azwj</sup> did not Impoverish you all in order to Abase you, but rather, I Chose you all for the like of this Day.
Browse through the faces of the people, so the ones who were good towards you, not being good except for Me<sup>azwj</sup>, so compensate them from Me<sup>azwj</sup>, with the Paradise”’.
en.sarwar: 15. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn abu Nasr from ‘Isa al-Farra’ from Muhammad ibn Muslim from abu Ja’far (a.s.) who has said the following:
“When it will be the Day of Judgment, Allah, the Most Blessed, the Most High, will command an announcer to announce and call before Him, ‘Where are the poor people?’

certain heads will rise and they will be many. Allah will say, ‘My servants.’ They will say, ‘Yes, our Lord.’ Allah will say, ‘I did not make you poor considering you as insignificant. I chose you for this day.
Search among the people those who helped you for My sake and compensate them on My behalf with paradise.’”
